description: This source file implements the core logic of the 'Network' plugin in a larger software system, handling network interfaces, IP configurations, connectivity status, IP address management, event handling via IARM, and exposing various JSON RPC methods for managing network operations in a device or embedded system environment.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: Main class implementing network management features including interface handling, IP configurations, event processing, and RPC method exposures.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the network plugin, registers event handlers, and sets up internal state.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters event handlers, and resets internal state.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a string with plugin information (empty in this implementation).

methods.name: isValidCIDRv4
methods.description: Validates whether a given CIDR prefix is valid for IPv4 addresses.

methods.name: retryIarmEventRegistration
methods.description: Starts a thread to retry event handler registration with IARM bus.

methods.name: threadEventRegistration
methods.description: Thread function to attempt registration of IARM event handlers.

methods.name: getQuirks
methods.description: Returns plugin quirks/features.

methods.name: getInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves list of network interfaces.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Gets the current default network interface.

methods.name: setDefaultInterface
methods.description: Sets the default network interface.

methods.name: getStbIp
methods.description: Retrieves the current IP address of the device (STB).

methods.name: getSTBIPFamily
methods.description: Gets IP address for a specified IP family (IPv4 or IPv6).

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific network interface is enabled.

methods.name: setInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific network interface.

methods.name: getNamedEndpoints
methods.description: Returns list of named network endpoints (e.g., CMTS).

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Performs a network trace route to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: traceNamedEndpoint
methods.description: Performs a trace route to a named network endpoint.

methods.name: ping
methods.description: Pings a network endpoint.

methods.name: pingNamedEndpoint
methods.description: Pings a named network endpoint.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for a network interface.

methods.name: setIPSettings2
methods.description: Configures IP settings with detailed parameters.

methods.name: setIPSettingsInternal
methods.description: Internal method to apply IP configuration settings.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves current IP configuration.

methods.name: getIPSettings2
methods.description: Retrieves detailed IP configuration information.

methods.name: getIPSettingsInternal
methods.description: Internal method to get IP settings info.

methods.name: getIPIARMWrapper
methods.description: Wraps an IARM call to get IP settings.

methods.name: isConnectedToInternet
methods.description: Checks if device is connected to internet.

methods.name: setConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Sets URLs for connectivity testing.

methods.name: getInternetConnectionState
methods.description: Returns current internet connection status.

methods.name: getCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Provides URI of captive portal if present.

methods.name: startConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Starts continuous connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: stopConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Stops connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: getPublicIP
methods.description: Retrieves public IP address using STUN server.

methods.name: setStunEndPoint
methods.description: Configures the STUN server endpoint.

methods.name: configurePNI
methods.description: Configures the Packet Network Interface (PNI).

methods.name: getPublicIPInternal
methods.description: Internal function to get public IP via STUN.

methods.name: notifyInternetStatusChange
methods.description: Notifies system about internet status change.

methods.name: onInterfaceEnabledStatusChanged
methods.description: Event handler for interface enabled status changes.

methods.name: onInterfaceConnectionStatusChanged
methods.description: Event handler for interface connectivity status changes.

methods.name: onInternetStatusChange
methods.description: Event handler for overall internet connectivity status.

methods.name: onInterfaceIPAddressChanged
methods.description: Event handler for IP address acquisition or loss on an interface.

methods.name: onDefaultInterfaceChanged
methods.description: Event handler for default interface change.

methods.name: eventHandler
methods.description: Static event handler called by IARM to dispatch events.

methods.name: iarmEventHandler
methods.description: Instance method to handle IARM bus events.

methods.name: iarmEventHandler
methods.description: Instance method to handle IARM bus events, processing various event types such as interface enabled status, connection status, IP address changes, and default interface changes.

methods.name: _getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve default network interface and gateway either via scripts for hybrid devices or via IARM bus call for media devices.
